candidates.issues: Best match for the photo: an individual plated portion with yellow custard cream and milk chocolate. The milk custard may make the cream slightly loose. Otherwise the method is safe and clear.
Zabaglione cream and milk chocolate suit the image well, and the yolks are cooked. No dish size is given.
The eggless cream will be whiter than the yellowish cream shown. Otherwise solid, with a pan size and clear ladyfinger counts.
